cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Naučit studenty základům konstrukce a funkce výrobní techniky se zaměřením na hlavní, pomocné a opěrné mechanismy stroje. Předmět poskytuje studentům základní znalosti a informace o pohonných motorech, převodových, kinematických, hydraulických a pneumatických mechanismech. Dále je předmět zaměřen na systémy odsávání odpadů a prašné vzduchotechniky. Samostatnou částí je přehled dřevoobráběcích nástrojů a jejich upínání na vřetenu stroje.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the course is to learn students basics of design and function of production technology with a focus on the main, auxiliary and supporting mechanisms of the machine. The subject provides students with basic knowledge and information about drive motors, gear, kinematic, hydraulic and pneumatic mechanisms. Furthermore, the course is focused on waste extraction systems and dust ventilation. A separate part is an overview of woodworking tools and their clamping on the machine spindle.

I (allowance 2/2) a.Belts and belt transmissions, variatorsb.Ropes and rope transmissions5.Transmission mechanisms - II (allowance 2/2) a.Chains and chain transmissionsb.Gears and gearboxes6.Transmission parts (allowance 2/2) a.Axles, shafts and bearingsb.Spindles and knife shaftsc.Shaft couplings7.Kinematic mechanisms (allowance 0/0) a.Crank, sliding and cam mechanismb.Maltese mechanism, ratchet and latch system8.Hydraulic elements and mechanisms (allowance 2/2) a.Selected hydraulic elementsb.Arangement of hydraulic circuits - schema renderingc.Hydraulic fluids9.Hydrostatic circuits of woodworking machines (allowance 2/2) a.Hydraulics of splitting and sawing machinesb.Hydraulic presses and bending machinesc.Hydraulics of log handling machines10.Woodworking tools (allowance 2/2) a.Classification of tools, structures and materialsb.Tool geometry and clamping11.Pneumatic elements and mechanisms (allowance 2/2) a.Construction of pneumatic elements and typical circuitsb.Pneumatic of fixing, pressing, insertion and removal equipment for woodworking machines12.Ventilation equipment (allowance 2/2) a.Fans, air ducts, filters and dirt separatorsb.Extraction of waste from woodworking machines, covers, ventilation13.Main exercises (allowance 2/10) a.Design and function of high-productivity milling machine, operating parameters, possibilities of high-productivity milling of solid woodb.Design and manufacturing of individual machine groups of woodworking machines and tools (TOS Svitavy, Rojek a.s., Pilana a.s.).14.Credit week (allowance 2/2) a.Credit testb.Evaluation of semestral project
